title: Vocabulary file
description: The words a lesson teaches. This is the single source for both the vocabulary screen and the SRS step — the srs section collects from here, so there is no parallel card list. Every word should be tied to a lesson goal and used by at least one exercise; a word nothing teaches does not belong here.

theme.description: The vocabulary theme this lesson teaches, from guides/a1-vocabulary-themes.md. Groups words into a topic deck, so it is shared by every lesson covering that topic rather than being unique per lesson.

lemma.description: Dictionary form, lower case, as it will be stored in the SRS deck. Multi-word expressions and questions are written out in full, including punctuation, because that is how the reader's phrase lookup finds them.

pos.description: Use 'expression' for anything longer than a single word. A word that is genuinely two classes may join them with a slash, as in 'noun/adjective' for joven — but only where both readings are taught, since this string is shown to the learner verbatim on the card.
